latest.title: WARDOGS | Season 02 Preview
latest.summary: Season 02 introduces new weapons, vehicles, weather systems, wager mechanics, balance updates, faction adjustments, press conference features, awards, contests, and more.

details: Season 01 recap + Season 02 preview VLOG released
Season 01 is ending; developers thank players for 3+ million sales
Players are encouraged to return whenever they want during early development
Molotov: incendiary splash fire, overarm/underarm throws
T-72: slower than Leopard, cheaper, fuel-efficient
MG Nest: manned M2 Browning emplacement
Large Shelter: metal shelter for assets/weather
Thunder sync across server; can mask footsteps
May be removed mid-season if exploitable
Super heavy helmets: muffled audio, restricted FOV, fogging
Heavy/super heavy helmets: increased suppression resistance
Improved squad coordination, vehicle handling, controller responsiveness
Performance optimisations, bug fixes, server stability
Lonestar lowest win rate; sentiment major factor
All faction spawns moved on Bakurani
Lonestar cash & XP win bonus (Season 2 only)
Vendor discount: 20% off for losing team if 40+ points behind
Supports trailers, VLOGs, press conferences, podcasts, social accounts
Golden Joystick nomination: Best Early Access Game 2026
Full notes release early next week
Season 2 trailer releases with patch notes
Top 100k premiere on BULKHEAD YouTube channel
